positions.title: Studio Lead
positions.description:
Fruit Scoot
Led the development of the company's first match-3 game using the Unity game engine.  Responsible for the overall game design, game piece mechanics, level progression, theme and story.  Designed innovative new features including the ability for players to help their friends pass difficult levels to improve long-term retention and timed challenges to increase monetization.

Fantasy Slots
Led the development of a new Facebook slots game.  Designed 8 original slot machines based on classic stories, including unique slot machine mechanics, pay out tables, reel configuration, and the interconnection between the free-spins rounds, fantasy neighbors, and daily bonus games.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Collaborated with another game development company to create Flower Shop, a Facebook canvas game.  Conceived of and designed the core gameplay, viral features and monetization strategy.  Notable features include floral arrangements, hiring employees, greenhouse, laboratory, farmers market, and amusement park features.
